# Know the special assessment before it happens.

> Free calculator for HOA/condo board treasurers: project whether your current reserve contribution covers known roof, repaving, painting, pool, elevator, and HVAC replacements, or find the year a special assessment hits, then solve the minimum contribution to avoid it.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
